title: Physician couple annual review: backdoor Roth, disability insurance and 529s for three children
notes: Three figures are superseded mid-meeting: the Wrenfield IRA balance (84,000 at 00:09:12, corrected to 48,210 at 00:14:16), the retirement age (60 at 00:03:41, revised by both clients to 58 at 00:21:38) and the IRA limit (Declan's $7,000, corrected by Renata to $7,500 at 00:08:02), and two transcription errors ('$50,000' for fifteen thousand, 'Pell Wood' for Pellwood) are fixed in the next turn. The roll-in question moves from Declan to Theo while Declan keeps a separate Marisa errand for the partner LTD documents, Priya's LTD upload moves from Friday to Wednesday October 21, five floated ideas (457(b), 529 superfunding, cash balance plan, lake house, 100% or 90/10 equity) must stay out of the action lists, and the closing recap omits the CPA note, the e-sign packet and Declan's partnership documents. Each keyed account action covers both spouses or all three children, so a system that splits the backdoor Roth per spouse or the 529 change per child (open Callum's, raise Rowan's and Ivy's) has listed parts of one keyed action, to be treated as duplicates rather than extra actions.

retirement_target.expected: Age 58 for both Priya and Declan (2043), revised in the meeting from 60

Saint Brennock Medical Center (Priya's employer) announced in September 2026 an affiliation, in effect a merger, with Aldmere Health, expected to close in the first quarter of 2027; her contract is honored through June 2028 and benefits are to be harmonized

account_actions.expected: Roll over Declan's traditional (rollover) IRA at Wrenfield Securities, full balance of about $48,210, into the Coldharbor Emergency Associates partners' 401(k), completed before December 31, 2026 to clear the pro-rata rule

Backdoor Roth for 2026: $7,500 nondeductible traditional IRA contribution for each of Priya and Declan ($15,000 total), converted into their Roth IRAs; Priya's as soon as her account is open, Declan's in December once his IRA balance is zero
Open a 529 for Callum and set automatic contributions of $1,000 a month for each of the three children (Rowan and Ivy increased from $500; $3,000 a month total), first draft November 1, 2026
